notes: Taḥwīl «ح» joins Qutayba's branch and Ibn al-Sarh's branch; the names after the last «ح» (Ibn Wahb, Ibn Jurayj, Abu al-Zubayr, Jabir) are written once, so they are the shared tail
Branch one «قال حدثنا ح» gives no name between «قال حدثنا» and «ح»: the route stops at Qutayba and is not extended from memory
«- المعنى -» is an editor's gloss, left out
Abu Dawud's «روى هذا الحديث محمد بن بكر البرساني» and «ورواه أبو عاصم» name other transmitters for the same saying: variant groups, not routes; Abu Asim's version has no Companion named
